# Inter

`app/src/main/res/font/inter_*.ttf` are the Inter typeface, bundled so the app
renders with the same face as the approved PWA without a runtime font download.

- Upstream: https://github.com/rsms/inter
- Licence: SIL Open Font License 1.1 — https://openfontlicense.org
- Files were taken from the Google Fonts distribution (Inter v20) at weights
  400, 500, 600, 700 and 800.

The PDF writer separately embeds a Manrope subset (SIL OFL 1.1) so the rupee
sign prints; that is added in phase N5.
